mapper.select: SELECT * FROM parking_spot WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId} ORDER BY zone_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spot_code, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_spot SET status = #{status}, vehicle_no = #{vehicleNo}, user_id = #{userId}, order_id = #{orderId}, start_time = #{startTime}, planned_end_time = #{plannedEndTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE parking_spot SET status = 0, vehicle_no = NULL, user_id = NULL, order_id = NULL, start_time = NULL, planned_end_time = NULL, actual_end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_spot WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId} AND status = 0
